releases.name: LinBox Bionic Box64 v0.4.4 (aarch64)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置
  同款 box64 与配套文件，单独升级时才需要本包

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16: LAN sin bloqueos y reportes más completos

### Cambios

- **Crear carrera LAN ya no detiene el juego si tu `server.dll` es de otra versión.** Antes salía "Arranque guest detenido: server.dll: file layout does not match the lifted code" y el juego se paraba. Ahora aparece un aviso: ese teléfono no puede crear la carrera, pero sí unirse a una que cree otro jugador. Para crearla, copia el `server.dll` de la misma instalación de PC de donde sacaste el ejecutable del juego.
- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En estos procesadores eso los metía todos en solo 2 núcleos, y el juego iba peor que antes. Ahora solo se fijan cuando hay al menos 4 núcleos rápidos; si no, Android los reparte como antes.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

Revisamos los reportes de la v0.1.13. La protección para GPU PowerVR funcionó: el Moto g54 ya pasa del primer dibujo. Esta versión corrige el cierre más repetido y hace que los reportes traigan la información que necesitamos.

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13: mega actualización

Revisamos uno por uno los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión corrige los fallos más repetidos y añade lo necesario para que los próximos reportes traigan toda la información.

### Gráficos

- **Detalle de las sombras ya se puede activar.** El juego solo habilita esa opción con tarjetas NVIDIA o ATI. Ahora el port se presenta como una NVIDIA GeForce 7800 GTX, así que la opción se puede subir y las sombras se dibujan en carrera.
- **Texturas DXT1 con transparencia correcta.** Se convierten a A1R5G5B5, como ya hace Carbon: menos memoria y bordes recortados correctos.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico, en los cuatro juegos. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Estabilidad

DolphinVR Redux v0.5 brings VR game patches, which put your hands and your head into the games themselves, an in-game menu you use without taking the headset off, a large round of Meta Quest performance work, and automatic updates on Windows.

- **VR game patches.** The arm cannon follows your controller in the Metroid Prime games, the gun and sword follow it in Red Steel 1 and 2, Skyward Sword reads your controller's true pose, and Twilight Princess, The Wind Waker, Wii Sports and Shadow the Hedgehog can be played in first person.

releases.name: v1.0.8
releases.body:
## EmuFive 1.0.8: big games run much faster

### What's new
- **Games with very large buffers run much faster.** 1.0.7 uploaded every recently used buffer whole each frame, which for a game like Teardown meant over 3 GB per frame. Now only small buffers (up to 4 MB) are uploaded that way; large ones are tracked by page again. Teardown on a PS4 Pro went from under 1 FPS to about 2.4 FPS. DREDGE keeps its 1.0.7 speed and clean sound.
- **A new emulator build** (KytyPS5 589bd14 with EmuFive patches 0001–0032).

### Teardown and other big games: more GPU memory
Teardown also needs the GPU to be allowed up to 5 GB of system RAM, or it stops with GPU out of memory. Use the `bootargs.txt` of [PS4 Multiboot v1.5.0-beta-5](https://github.com/blue0x1/ps4-multiboot/releases/tag/v1.5.0-beta.5) (copy it to `/data/linux/boot/` over FTP), or add `amdgpu.gttsize=5120 ttm.pages_limit=1310720` to the end of the line in your own.

### Update
Settings, System, Software update. No restart is needed. Coming from 1.0.6 or earlier, it installs 1.0.7 first, which also updates the PS4 Mesa (see the 1.0.7 notes).

From 1.0.3 or earlier, start the update once by hand (see the README's Changelog).

### What's new
- **Faster games.** The emulator uploads buffers to the GPU in batches and waits on it less often. DREDGE on a PS4 Pro went from about 12 to 13–28 FPS, and 44–50 FPS in lighter views, and its sound no longer crackles.
- **A new emulator build** (KytyPS5 589bd14 with EmuFive patches 0001–0031): better memory use, GPU caches and shader translation, on top of the speed-ups above.
- **Smooth cover changes on the home screen.** Moving between games now changes the cover smoothly. Pick the effect in Settings, Appearance, Motion, Cover change. There are 11: fade, slide, zoom, wipe, dark, parallax, blinds, doors, push, iris and pixelate.
- **New PS4 Mesa.** The update installs the PS4 Mesa of PS4 Multiboot v1.5.0-beta-4, which is needed for all 4 GPU engines on the PS4 Pro (below).

### Update
1. Optional: copy `ps4-mesa.tar.xz` from [PS4 Multiboot v1.5.0-beta-4](https://github.com/blue0x1/ps4-multiboot/releases/tag/v1.5.0-beta.4) to `/user/home/` over FTP. The update takes it from there; without it, the PS4 needs to be online and downloads it (about 45 MB).

releases.body:
# WWE '12 PC 1.4.0

The match-options update: new match rules in the menus (starting finishers, squash, I QUIT, Special Guest Referee), a Universe chaos level, Mod Maker additions and fixes for what you reported after 1.3.0.

## New match options

- **Starting finishers (as in WWE 2K14).** On the character select, press **LT / RT** on a place to choose how many finishers that wrestler starts with: NONE, 1, 2, 3 or INFINITE. It shows in the title of the attire frame (or in the READY banner for wrestlers with only one attire). Left on NORMAL, nothing changes. *Limit:* in a few match types the game skips the attire frame, so the option is only offered in a normal 1 on 1.
- **Squash matches.** In **OPTIONS > GAMEPLAY > BALANCING > DAMAGE** (the page now has three new lines): **SQUASH CHANCE** (0-100 %, the chance that a 1 on 1 match is a squash; 0 = off, the default), **SQUASH: JOBBER HEALTH** (starting health of the lower-rated wrestler, 20 % by default) and **STARTING FINISHERS** (default for every match). The lower-rated wrestler is the jobber; the other one starts with a finisher. The labels of the three new lines are in English only.

releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.body:
**WWE '12 PC v1.3.0 — "Speed and fixes"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Faster
- **Loading screens shorter** (a match loads in about 1.5 s instead of 4 s, the end of the entrances in about 1.9 s instead of 4.5 s). `wwe12_fast_loading = false` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Faster start-up** on PCs with 8 or more logical processors: the title screen comes after about 5-7 s instead of 15 s. On smaller processors the normal start-up is kept (`wwe12_fast_boot_min_threads`).
- **Sharper picture** when the game is drawn at 720p on a bigger screen (`svr_upscale_sharpness`, 0 turns it off).
- **Adaptive V-sync**: a late frame is shown at once instead of waiting a whole refresh (`svr_adaptive_vsync`).
- **Performance test** in the launcher (button *Performance test*): it plays a recorded 1-on-1 match with entrances once and tells you if your PC is fine, limited by the processor or by the graphics card. Nothing is changed without your agreement.

### Frame rate

**WWE '12 PC v1.2.0 — "Moveset update"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Match-start stutter (and a short freeze) on integrated graphics (Intel...)**: the game's reads of the picture back from the graphics card are now grouped at the end of the frame (about 10 times less waiting at the start of a match). `svr_readback_defer_streak = false` goes back to 1.1.
- **Less work for the processor every frame** (helps small PCs, issue #53): shader constants are reused like on Android (`svr_reuse_constant_blocks`) and the check of 3D models is lighter (`svr_geometry_sample_min`, 32768 brings the 1.1 behaviour back).
- **Crash at start with file names that have accents or other characters** (for example a song called "Café.mp3" or a mod folder with Japanese letters in a mod): names are now read as UTF-8 everywhere in the game, the launcher and the Mod Maker, and a mod with an unreadable name is skipped instead of closing the game.
- **Launcher: the MUSIC page closed the launcher** when a file in the `music` folder had an odd name.

releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
**WWE '12 PC v1.1.0**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Universe: crash with 5 or more matches per weekly show** (RAW / SmackDown set to 5 or 6 matches, especially in the weeks after some PPVs, and the show after WrestleMania). Fixed and tested over several simulated months.
- **Universe: the extra matches no longer repeat "#1 contender" matches** (the same wrestlers twice on one card), and a show set to 6 matches now gets its 6 matches week after week (the game's 7-day rest rule used to drop matches).
- **Direct3D 12 on older Intel graphics (UHD 620): half-transparent wrestlers and ring** fixed (#7). New setting `svr_d3d12_depth_flip` (true by default; `false` = 1.0 behaviour).
- **Damaged / white Superstar Threads attires on slower PCs** fixed (fix adapted from KaikoClanworth1's SvR 2011 PC port).
- **Direct3D 11: broken wrestler skin on old NVIDIA cards such as the GeForce GT 430** fixed (#55; fix adapted from KaikoClanworth1's SvR 2011 PC port).

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.6 (beta 38): a água tem colisão de novo, e menos lentidão depois de carregar
releases.body:
**Beta 38.** O Link não atravessa mais a água dos rios depois de um tempo jogando, o jogo volta à velocidade normal 1 s depois de cada carregamento, e vários fechamentos foram corrigidos. Várias correções vieram de colaboradores (obrigado, Propinbo!).

## Correções

- **Água sem colisão depois de um tempo (#296, #438):** depois de 30-60 min, o Link afundava nos rios e andava no fundo, com a água ainda desenhada por cima. Só reiniciar o app resolvia.
  - **Causa:** um pedaço da textura de altura da água era recriado em branco e escrito de volta por cima do que o jogo usa para a colisão.
  - **Agora:** o conteúdo é carregado antes. Correção do Propinbo (#461).
- **Lento por ~10 s depois de cada carregamento (#465):** depois de carregar o save ou de uma viagem rápida, o "Sync lag" (Vídeo) ficava desligado por 300 quadros. Em GPUs mais fracas isso eram ~12 s a 17-20 fps.
  - **Agora:** ele volta depois de 1 s. A água continua certa (era o motivo da espera longa); conferido na torre do Grande Platô.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.5 (beta 37): menos memória presa e melhorias vindas do TOTK
releases.body:
**Beta 37.** Os shaders do jogo deixam de ficar para sempre na memória, o FXAA ficou mais leve, e chegam quatro melhorias do [TOTKDroid](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid): o relógio do modo Nativo nos aparelhos MediaTek, mais dois efeitos de áudio do jogo, e texturas e vértices no modo cópia (Mali, Xclipse).

## Memória

- **Shaders liberados ao reiniciar o jogo:** cada vez que o jogo era reiniciado ou voltava à tela inicial pelo menu do app, ficavam na memória todos os shaders e pipelines já montados. Agora eles são liberados. Num teste com 16 trocas de cena, a memória terminou em 1075 MB em vez de 1646 MB.
- **Shaders sem uso liberados na Mali e nas outras GPUs não Adreno (#450):** os shaders nunca eram liberados durante o jogo (1513 vivos depois de 30 min, quando uma Mali-G720 fechou no limite de memória do Android). Agora, passados de 1000, os que ficaram 10 min (depois 3 min) sem uso são liberados e montados de novo quando o jogo voltar a usá-los. Deve reduzir os fechamentos em sessões longas na Mali, mas ainda falta confirmar num aparelho Mali: se você tinha esse problema, conte se melhorou.

## Vindo do TOTK

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.4 (beta 36): sem queda de fps depois dos menus
releases.body:
# BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.4 (beta 36): sem queda de fps depois dos menus

**Beta 36.** O jogo volta à velocidade normal logo depois de um menu, e a geração de quadros chega a mais GPUs Mali.

## Correções

- **Queda de fps depois de qualquer menu (#374, #439, #433):** por uns 12 s depois de fechar o menu de pausa, o inventário ou a troca de runas, o jogo ficava em 20-27 fps e depois voltava ao normal.
  - **Causa:** ao fechar o menu, o app desligava o "Sync lag" (Vídeo) por 300 quadros, como depois de uma tela de carregamento.
  - **Agora:** o menu não conta mais como saída do mundo. No POCO F7 Ultra, os trechos de 2 s abaixo de 29 fps depois dos menus caíram de 12 para 0.
- **Preso em 20 fps depois de um engasgo:** um engasgo isolado (save, menu, shaders compilando) não leva mais o jogo para 20 fps. E, se ele estiver em 20 fps, tenta voltar a 30 a cada poucos segundos, em vez de esperar o trabalho por quadro cair muito.
- **Geração de quadros: "no Lossless.dll" com o arquivo no lugar certo (#437, #385):** o Android mostra o arquivo em Download/ para o app, mas não deixa abrir sem a permissão de acesso a todos os arquivos.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.3 (beta 35): geração de quadros em telas de 120 Hz ou mais
releases.body:
**Beta 35.** A geração de quadros (LSFG) agora funciona em celulares em que o Android deixava o jogo a 60 Hz mesmo com uma tela mais rápida, como no ROG Phone 8.

## Correções

- **Geração de quadros sem efeito em telas rápidas:** com o jogo a 40–50 fps e a tela a 60 Hz, não sobrava espaço para nenhum quadro gerado, e o jogo continuava igual. Isso acontecia mesmo em telas de 120 ou 165 Hz, porque o Android deixa o jogo a 60 Hz se o app não pede outra taxa.
  - Agora, com a geração ligada, o app pede ao Android uma taxa com espaço para os quadros gerados: a taxa de quadros escolhida vezes o multiplicador (60 fps × 2 = 120 Hz). O sistema escolhe o modo mais próximo que a tela tem.
  - Se ainda assim não couber nenhum quadro, Vídeo > Geração de quadros agora diz isso, em vez de "gerando". Para abrir espaço, aumente a taxa de atualização nas configurações de tela ou do modo jogo do celular (no ROG, o Game Genie), ou baixe a Taxa de quadros.

> **Não precisa compilar o código do jogo de novo:** é só instalar por cima.

## Problemas conhecidos

- **4 GB de RAM:** perto de 20 fps no mundo, mas ainda abaixo disso na média, e o fps cai quando o aparelho esquenta.

releases.name: BOTWRecompAndroid 0.4.2 (beta 34): mais fps no Turnip, economia de RAM no menu
releases.body:
**Beta 34.** Celulares com Turnip em que a GPU esperava pela CPU ficaram mais rápidos: no Galaxy Tab A9+, o jogo foi de ~15 para ~19 fps no mundo. O modo de economia de RAM agora pode ser escolhido no menu.

## Desempenho

- **Turnip, todos os celulares:** cada envio de trabalho para a GPU esperava a GPU terminar o envio anterior. Por isso a GPU ficava ~14 ms parada dentro de cada quadro, esperando o próximo envio. Agora o app acompanha o progresso da GPU sem prender o envio.
  - **Galaxy Tab A9+** (Adreno 619): no mundo, de ~15 para ~19 fps, com trechos acima de 20. A GPU parada caiu para ~7,5 ms por quadro.
  - **POCO F7 Ultra** (Adreno 830): igual (~25–26 fps), porque lá o limite já é a própria GPU.
  - Outros drivers (Mali, Xclipse, o driver da Qualcomm) não tinham esse problema e continuam como antes.
- **Resolução de saída "Automático" com a economia de RAM ligada:** no máximo 720p. Nos aparelhos fracos a GPU é o limite, e aumentar a imagem final para 1080p custava quadros. No Tab A9+, o tempo de GPU por quadro caiu de ~74 para ~61 ms. Nos outros aparelhos, o Automático continua igual.

It also introduces the "setups" concept, which enables you to define an MSX setup (e.g. a Philips VG 8020 with an external disk drive and a joystick, data recorder and printer connected). These can be created, loaded, and automatically started. They can also be saved automatically when you exit.

Furthermore, flash chip emulation has become a lot more accurate, thanks to Laurens Holst.

releases.name: openMSX 20.0
releases.body:
openMSX 20.0—Autumn Spring—is a major release, in which we introduce the new Graphical User Interface, replacing the OSD menu. A faster and more powerful debugger is now included in openMSX itself. Configuration for MSX joystick/JoyMega has been improved drastically using the new GUI. If you still want to use Catapult, you can use the Catapult release that came with openMSX 19.0. Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_20_0/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

As always, special thanks to all the contributors of this release who are not in the core team! Keep these pull requests coming!

Please note that as of now, a system with OpenGL 2 support is required to run openMSX.

releases.name: openMSX 19.1
releases.body:
openMSX 19.1—Reflection—is a bug fix release for openMSX 19.0, as we found some rather nasty issues after releasing, mostly that LaserDisc support was broken. No new Catapult will be released, as it has no changes.  Please [read the release notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openMSX/openMSX/RELEASE_19_1/doc/release-notes.txt) for details of the openMSX changes.

Thanks for those who gave us the feedback so that we found out about these issues.

Please note that this will be the last openMSX release that supports systems without OpenGL 2 or higher.

## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

### Changelog

The fix adds centralized log redaction for Steam/auth token fields, Steam QR login URLs, JWT-like token strings, and launch command token arguments before logs are written. This covers the app loggers, JavaSteam logging, and the PC launch-log file writer.

This release also pins local patch builds to `apktool 2.12.1`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite/compare/v5.1.7...v5.1.8

releases.body:
# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.

releases.name: hakuX 1.3.0
releases.body:
Xbox Live through Insignia, and game fixes.

### Xbox Live
- **Insignia** — Settings → Network → Connection → Xbox Live: Insignia connects the console to Insignia, the revival of the original Xbox Live: Live games sign in, find matches and play online. If your Internet provider blocks Insignia's DNS server, point it at a computer running insigniaDNS instead
- **Xbox Live setup** — Settings → Network → Xbox Live setup walks you through it, one step at a time: the connection, the Xbox dashboard, registering the console with Insignia's Setup Assistant (downloaded for you), then making or recovering your account in the dashboard
- **Dashboard** — the library's Dashboard button (top left) starts the Xbox dashboard from the console's hard disk, where Xbox Live accounts are made and recovered. The first time, it installs the dashboard from a zip of its files (dashboard 5960) that you provide: hakuX doesn't include one
- **Title updates** — a game's Xbox Live update, once downloaded, starts with the game. Forza Motorsport's 60 and 120 fps mods cover its update too

### Games
- **Fable: The Lost Chapters** — the hero's face and arms are no longer black or noise

releases.name: hakuX 1.2.0
releases.body:
System link, stability and compatibility improvements.

### Network
- **System link over your network** — Settings → Network → System link → LAN: hakuX devices on the same Wi-Fi network find each other as Xbox consoles on a LAN do. Devices the network's broadcasts don't reach, on another subnet or a VPN such as ZeroTier or Tailscale, are added by address under Other consoles
- **XLink Kai** — system link over the Internet through an XLink Kai engine running on a computer on your network; its web page picks the game's arena
- **Console identity** — each console has its own serial number, network address and online key. A device whose hard disk was copied from another one offers to make itself a new identity, since two consoles with one identity can't see each other


### Games
- **Sega GT 2002** — the cars have their paint, reflections and sun highlights
- **Doom 3** — no longer crashes as its main menu loads
- **Fatal Frame II** — starts and reads its disc in the order it asks for
- **AirForce Delta Storm** — answers the controller and the on-screen controls (it ignored all input)
- **Silent Hill 2** — no longer crashes when it loads a room

releases.name: hakuX 1.1.0
releases.body:
GPUs beyond Adreno (experimental).

### GPUs
- **Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR (experimental)** — hakuX runs on GPUs other than Adreno: features they lack are replaced (BC and 4444 textures decoded up front, standard border colours, the push block in a buffer, D32S8 depth), and known driver bugs are worked around (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`). Burnout 3 and Mercenaries run cleanly on a Pixel 8 (Mali-G715)
- **Vulkan 1.1 drivers** — GPUs whose drivers stop at Vulkan 1.1 (Valhall Mali on older or vendor-capped drivers, Qualcomm's own older drivers, early Xclipse, PowerVR BXM) run through a compatibility layer (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/compat.c`)
- **Older GPUs without descriptor indexing (experimental)** — Bifrost Mali (G71, G72, G76, G52) and PowerVR Rogue: each draw binds its own textures, and depth is clamped in the shader where the GPU can't
- **Adreno** — unchanged: every replacement is off where the GPU has the feature.

### App
- **GPU driver** — a screen of its own (Settings → GPU driver): the system driver and the stored packages in one list, with their versions and authors. Packages are checked when added and can be deleted (deleting the one in use goes back to the system driver)

releases.name: hakuX 1.0.0
releases.body:
A new core replaces xemu's QEMU-based one.

### New core
- **CPU** — the Xbox's x86 code runs on a FEX JIT (FEXCore fork), and the Xbox kernel is reimplemented natively (`native/kernel`): no QEMU
- **GPU** — the NV2A push buffer is decoded into Vulkan (HLE, `hw/xbox/hle`). Custom drivers (Turnip) load through adrenotools; driver-specific workarounds are quirks (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`, `debug.hakux.quirks`)
- **Audio** — the MCPX APU runs on the core's own services (`native/dev/apu`), out through AAudio
- **Savestates** — per game, in slots, with the hard disk's files
- **Mods and cheats** — per game, from `mods/` (library long-press "Mods & cheats"): XBE patches and replaced disc files; 60 and 120 fps mods for 13 games (`mods/README.md`, generators in `tools/mods`)
- **Controllers** — each physical controller routed to a player with its own mapping; the on-screen controller adds to player 1

### New features
- **Updates** — hakuX looks for a newer release on GitHub when it starts and on demand (Settings → Updates); one found shows its notes and installs from there
- **Frontends** — a game launched from ES-DE or another frontend returns to it when it closes

# SeedlessDS 1.1 正式版

版本名为 `1.1`，版本号为 `153`。本次同时发布原包名替换版、共存版、对应源码及 SHA-256 校验文件。两版均关闭 Android 调试标志，正式版本号与发布文件名均不含 debug，测试控制面板关闭。

## 本次改进

- 修复后台存档提前完成时，完成状态被模拟线程覆盖，导致后续快速存档和读档一直被忽略的问题。
- 减少存读档结束后的多余槽位查询、成就附加档读取和目录扫描，成就校验改为流式 SHA-256。
- 拆分即时存档、游戏电池存档和其它文件的访问锁，避免后台慢存档连带阻塞游戏文件读取。后台存档线程降低优先级。
- 防止并发慢查询重新发布已失效的目录列表，修复日志时间格式化的并发访问。
- 在应用私有目录保留有大小上限的近期存读档记录，便于追查偶发卡顿。
- 保留 SoundTouch 原声音高加速、低延迟音频恢复修复，以及按 RP Duo 上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜。

## 安装包选择

| 文件 | Android 包名 | 安装方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `seedless-ds-1.1-coexist.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` | 可直接更新本分支旧共存版，也可与官方版共存 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-replacement.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app` | 原包名替换版 |
| `seedless-ds-fork-1.1-src.zip` | — | 两版对应的完整源码与构建配置 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-SHA256.txt` | — | 安装包和源码校验值 |

共存版按用户选择保留历史包名中的 `.debug`，以支持覆盖更新，应用本身已关闭调试。两版均沿用本分支旧签名。

替换版与官方版签名不同。首次换用替换版，请先导出存档与配置，再卸载官方版并安装。直接覆盖官方版会因签名不匹配而失败。两个包名的数据各自独立，切换使用时需导入存档。

两版均支持 ARM64，最低 Android 5.0。证书 SHA-256 为 `99e2395bd7c458a577e6bc4f4c7237a7474cb20a178fad07313c2778a7943165`，沿用仓库随源公开测试签名。

## 验证范围

- 两种正式构建各 128 项应用测试通过，完成构建、Lint、包名和签名检查，并核对 `debuggable=false`、`testOnly=false` 及 `BuildConfig.DEBUG=false`。两版的应用资源和原生库一致。
- 原生回归覆盖 21 类存档故障、280 轮重复存读档及请求交错。

# 原声加速修复与 RP Duo 滤镜

加速时使用 SoundTouch 保留音高，音乐和音效节奏随游戏加快。修复此前加速连续爆音，以及 1.0.38 加速声音尖锐的问题。RP Duo 用户已确认 1.0.39“音色自然了，效果合适”。

包含按上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的 Vulkan 柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜，以及低延迟音频的暂停恢复和异常回退修复。

## 下载选择

| 文件后缀 | 用途 | Android 包名 |
|---|---|---|
| `replacement.apk` | 原包名替换版 | `com.seedlessds.app` |
| `coexist.apk` | 与官方版共存，可更新本分支旧共存版 | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` |
| `src.zip` | 两版对应源码，包含 SoundTouch 及构建配置 | — |
| `SHA256.txt` | 安装包和源码校验值 | — |

**替换版与官方版签名不同。首次换用替换版，请先导出游戏存档和配置，再卸载官方版并安装。** 直接覆盖官方版会因签名不匹配而失败。替换版后续可使用本分支同签名安装包更新。

两种包名的数据各自独立，需要分别授权游戏目录并导入存档。两个 APK 均为 ARM64，最低 Android 5.0，版本为 `1.0.39-natural-audio`，版本号为 `149`。

## 验证

- 替换版与共存版各 115 项应用测试通过，34 项 AAudio 回归、9 项 OpenSL 队列回归通过。
- RP Duo 运行生产变速代码，检查 0.5–64 倍的音高、时长、分块一致性、切速与缓存清理。
- 两种安装包构建与包名、签名检查通过，替换版通过独立 Lint 检查。
- 共存版完成 RP Duo 用户听测确认。替换版尚未在掌机安装听测，所有游戏和长时间高倍率运行尚未逐项覆盖。

两版沿用本分支公开测试签名。证书 SHA-256 为 `99e2395bd7c458a577e6bc4f4c7237a7474cb20a178fad07313c2778a7943165`。

感谢 SapphireRhodonite / SeedlessDS、WatermelonDS、SuperDrastic、SoundTouch 及滤镜作者。源码包含对应许可证与来源记录。

# SeedlessDS 1.1 正式版

版本名为 `1.1`，版本号为 `153`。本次同时发布原包名替换版、共存版、对应源码及 SHA-256 校验文件。两版均关闭 Android 调试标志，正式版本号与发布文件名均不含 debug，测试控制面板关闭。

## 本次改进

- 修复后台存档提前完成时，完成状态被模拟线程覆盖，导致后续快速存档和读档一直被忽略的问题。
- 减少存读档结束后的多余槽位查询、成就附加档读取和目录扫描，成就校验改为流式 SHA-256。
- 拆分即时存档、游戏电池存档和其它文件的访问锁，避免后台慢存档连带阻塞游戏文件读取。后台存档线程降低优先级。
- 防止并发慢查询重新发布已失效的目录列表，修复日志时间格式化的并发访问。
- 在应用私有目录保留有大小上限的近期存读档记录，便于追查偶发卡顿。
- 保留 SoundTouch 原声音高加速、低延迟音频恢复修复，以及按 RP Duo 上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜。

## 安装包选择

| 文件 | Android 包名 | 安装方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `seedless-ds-1.1-coexist.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` | 可直接更新本分支旧共存版，也可与官方版共存 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-replacement.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app` | 原包名替换版 |
| `seedless-ds-fork-1.1-src.zip` | — | 两版对应的完整源码与构建配置 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-SHA256.txt` | — | 安装包和源码校验值 |

共存版按用户选择保留历史包名中的 `.debug`，以支持覆盖更新，应用本身已关闭调试。两版均沿用本分支旧签名。

替换版与官方版签名不同。首次换用替换版，请先导出存档与配置，再卸载官方版并安装。直接覆盖官方版会因签名不匹配而失败。两个包名的数据各自独立，切换使用时需导入存档。

两版均支持 ARM64，最低 Android 5.0。证书 SHA-256 为 `99e2395bd7c458a577e6bc4f4c7237a7474cb20a178fad07313c2778a7943165`，沿用仓库随源公开测试签名。

## 验证范围

- 两种正式构建各 128 项应用测试通过，完成构建、Lint、包名和签名检查，并核对 `debuggable=false`、`testOnly=false` 及 `BuildConfig.DEBUG=false`。两版的应用资源和原生库一致。

## Hollow Knight: Silksong Android 2.0.0

**Note when updating from a previous version**: This will trigger the porting process again, but it is heavily cached, so should only take a few minutes.

This is a major release for this project, where the biggest change is that we have completely redesigned the bottom screen UI to feel more native to Silksongs design language. The bottom screen UI should now feel familiar to anyone who has used the in-game menu and any action can be taken from the bottom screen menu, making the in-game menu obsolete.

Thanks to Kaz Kirigiri for doing most of the design work and providing sketches for this revamped UI!

## Changes since 1.1.0

### Completely revamped bottom screen UI

- All tabs have been revamped to follow the in-game menu as close as possible
- Every action from the menu can now be done from the bottom screen. Use items, change crest and tools, place markers
- Smoothly animated item selection, tab switching, etc

## Changes since 2.0.0-rc1

### Dual screen
  - Zoom slider on the map: drag up to zoom in, down to zoom out. Fades out like RESET when you're not touching the map

## Hollow Knight: Silksong Android 1.1.0

**Note when updating from a previous version**: This will trigger the porting process again, but it is heavily cached, so should only take a few minutes.

### Mods (beta)
- Mod support: install BepInEx 5 plugins from a folder, build them into the game, and turn them on and off without rebuilding

### Display
- New setting: **Unlock aspect ratio** — fills non-16:9 screens completely (off by default, as it can have visual issues)

releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.4

Source revision: `c57e7f5d7608691bde97bc1c523c22ddf25604c6` (version code 7, version name `0.2.4-stable+c57e7f5`). A small update to 0.2.3.

### Fixes

- **Frame generation is smooth again when the game runs below half the screen's refresh rate.** The FPS counter used to double, but each generated frame and the real one reached the screen on back-to-back refreshes (about 8 ms apart, then a 25 ms gap), so motion looked no smoother than without frame generation. This was reported on a OnePlus 11 with BeamNG 0.34. Now the frames are shown evenly spaced, for example every 16.7 ms when 30 FPS is doubled to 60 on a 120 Hz screen. Checked for Linux games on Box64 + bionic and FEX + bionic. Windows games with frame generation go through the same code, but were not tested.
- Frame generation now caps the game's own frame rate at the screen's refresh rate divided by the multiplier (60 for 2x on a 120 Hz screen), since the extra frames could not be shown anyway.

Game profiles and the other registry files are read from the tag `v0.2.4` of the components repository (the same content as `v0.2.3`).

releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.2

Source revision: `48f360d1edca3859f72e447e6943a21ee8eede91` (version code 5, version name `0.2.2-stable+48f360d`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Same game presets on every phone**
- Game presets are no longer limited to particular processors, and the Snapdragon-specific BeamNG Box64 presets are gone. Every phone sees the same presets.
- Presets no longer name a GPU driver; the app picks one for your GPU:
  - Linux games get a Turnip driver when a preset is imported, when a shortcut is created and when a game starts. Adreno 735, 740 and 750 get Mesa Turnip 26.2.2; Adreno 730 gets Turnip v27.0.0 r6; Adreno 8xx keeps its current driver.
  - Windows games get the driver mapped to your GPU when they start, or the system driver when none is mapped.

**Crashes**
- Games no longer crash with SIGSYS on Android versions whose system-call filter refuses calls FEX makes (all FEX + bionic BeamNG starts on a POCO F6 with Android 14 died this way). A refused call now fails normally and is logged to `Winlator/logs/sigsys.log`.
- BeamNG 0.34 now starts on Box64 + bionic without PRoot. It used to crash about a second after start with exit 134 (seen on a OnePlus 11).

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.1
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.1

Source revision: `e750c469bed4a87644a1dac43ff7e1a137d32120` (version code 4, version name `0.2.1-stable+e750c46`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Counter-Strike 2**
- CS2 starts again on a fresh install. The game stopped with "A game file appears to be missing or corrupted" because its Panorama text library could not load next to the root filesystem's newer HarfBuzz. The app now carries the six small font libraries it needs (unmodified Debian 11 builds of HarfBuzz, FriBidi, libthai, libdatrie, Graphite2 and Pixman) instead of relying on Valve's Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper) being installed.
- The menu's background videos play from a Steam library on shared storage. The x86-64 and 32-bit x86 shims were missing the `flock` fallback that the aarch64 one already had, so file locks failed on shared storage.

**BeamNG.drive**
- BeamNG 0.39 and 0.40 now offer a single preset: FEX + bionic, no PRoot, direct launch, 960x544. The Box64, Box64 bionic, SoC-specific Box64 and Windows ARM64 presets are removed from those two versions; older BeamNG versions keep theirs.

releases.name: SkyNetEmu 0.2.0
releases.body:
## SkyNetEmu 0.2.0

Source revision: `5e2bcd1806815831a04d18b2b843735200461d0f` (version code 3, version name `0.2.0-stable+5e2bcd1`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Linux games on Android**
- Linux games can run on the bionic FEX without PRoot (direct FEX bridge), with game profiles and presets for BeamNG.drive 0.34, 0.39 and 0.40, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Rise of the Tomb Raider, Dead Island Definitive Edition, Alien: Isolation and Counter-Strike 2. A Box64 + bionic + no PRoot preset starts BeamNG 0.39 reliably.
- Games run directly from shared storage: FEX retries file mappings that Android's noexec storage refuses, so BeamNG no longer needs staged copies. The old staging code is removed, and its leftover files are deleted when a Linux session starts.
- Steam libraries on shared storage (`SkyNetEmu/Games`): installs work, installed games get shortcuts, and a fresh install finds games that are already downloaded there instead of offering to download them again.
- Tomb Raider (2013, 32-bit) runs from a shared-storage library on the PRoot glibc FEX.
- Android 16: FEX and the shim emulate `openat2` and `faccessat2` (BeamNG exited with SIGSYS).

releases.name: Winlator Ludashi 5.0
releases.body:
What's new:

## 🖥️ X++

\- Added **X++**, a native X server in C++ with asynchronous presentation for Android
\- X++ is now the default. The Java backend remains available as **X11**.
\- Reduced repeated scene work and improved Support for OpenGL, offscreen windows, XInput, and ARGB cursor handling.

## 🎮 Steam Integration

\- Added Steam support, downloads, library, online, Cloud saves.
\- Added friends, chat and achievement features
\- Improved offline setup, play your steam games offline without steam client
\- steam can be disabled in store settings.

## 💻 DisplayX

\- Rewrote Backend, updated transport, buffer completion and presentation scheduling.
\- Added SDR/HDR Support for compatible games/devices.

## 🎞️ Frame Generation

\- Added **LSFG**, adapted from Eden, and optional **WFG** (Winlator Frame Gen).
\- Added engine selection, quality and multiplier controls, adaptive pacing and refresh-rate limits.
\- WFG supports Vulkan 1.1 and direct output where supported, with a fallback path.
\- LSFG may need Turnip driver on renderer selection on A6xx devices.
\- Frame generation requires the Vulkan renderer. Compatibility and performance depend on the GPU, driver and game.

- Global settings with per-game overrides
- Touch controls you can rearrange and resize, and physical controllers

releases.body:
First release: Resident Evil HD Remaster (Nintendo Switch) on Android, built on the Eden v0.2.1 core with its own launcher.

**You need your own copy of the game** (`.nsp` or `.nsz`) and the `prod.keys` of your own Switch. The APK contains no game data, keys or firmware.

- Core cut to what this game calls; no network permission; Vulkan only.
- Engine mods built in: 60 fps, lighter shadows, scene resolution 960×720 / 1280×960 / 1600×1200, door skip.

- Touch controls built from the game's actions, layout editor, combo keys; Switch mods manager; driver import.
- Chris's campaign played through to the ending on a Retroid Pocket 5.
